title: Design a News Feed
interviewPrompt: For today's Software Engineer interview, design a news feed.

beats.interviewer: For today's Software Engineer interview, design a news feed.
beats.interviewee: Complete fan-out-on-write first: when you post, copy into every follower's Redis feed cache. Opening the app is one lookup. Full write and read path.
beats.show: Complete fan-out-on-write: post → fan-out → cache ← home read.

beats.interviewee: Reads are cheap on that complete system, but a celebrity post is 50 million writes. The write path is the bomb.
beats.show: Same complete system. Celebrity detonates the fan-out writes.

beats.interviewer: So dig into that celebrity case. What do you do?
beats.interviewee: Hybrid complete system: fan-out normals on write, skip fan-out for mega-accounts, merge their posts at read time into the home timeline.
beats.show: Hybrid complete: fan-out normals + merge celebs at read.

beats.interviewee: Only fan out to active followers so dormant accounts do not burn capacity. Same hybrid end-to-end system.
beats.show: Tune on full hybrid: fan out to active followers only.

beats.interviewee: Precompute the common path, compute the expensive path on demand. That is the whole complete design.
beats.show: Full system takeaway: precompute common, lazy expensive.
